content:
# Adding the Logs Bucket (knr-ops: Flux + kustomize + ACK)

## Repo layout after change

```
infra/
  s3-logs/                    # new bucket base
    bucket.yaml
    versioning.yaml
    encryption.yaml
    public-access-block.yaml
    kustomization.yaml
overlays/
  dev/s3-logs/
    kustomization.yaml
    role.yaml                 # IRSA role patch/base per env
    name-patch.yaml
  prod/s3-logs/
    kustomization.yaml
    role.yaml
    name-patch.yaml
flux/kustomizations.yaml      # updated
```

---

## Base: `infra/s3-logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    tags:
      Purpose: logs
      ManagedBy: ack
```

## `infra/s3-logs/versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchControllerRef: true
    versioningConfiguration:
      status: Enabled
```

## `infra/s3-logs/encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchControllerRef: true
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

## `infra/s3-logs/public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchControllerRef: true
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## `infra/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
```

*(Note: if an old-style example in this repo uses `s3.services.k8s.aws` namespaced CRDs, mirror that instead — controllerRef-based cross-resource linking above is the upbound pattern.)*

---

## Overlay: `overlays/dev/s3-logs/name-patch.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: logs
namePrefix: myapp-logs-dev-
```

## `overlays/dev/s3-logs/role.yaml` — IRSA role, least privilege, resource-scoped

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-irsa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/myapp-dev-logs-irsa # rendered by irsa-controller; kept explicit here
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com" },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": { "oidc.eks...:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:log-writer" }
          }
        }]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: logs-bucket-irsa
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev-*/*"},
          {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketVersioning"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev-*"}
        ]
      }
```

> Any account IDs / OIDC provider strings live as SOPS-encrypted values pulled via a `SopsSecretGenerator` in a real repo — never plaintext credentials.

## `overlays/dev/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: crossplane-system   # or wherever ACK resources reconcile
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3-logs
  - role.yaml
patches:
  - path: name-patch.yaml
commonLabels:
  env: dev
```

The prod overlay is identical except:
- `namePrefix: myapp-logs-prod-`
- `env: prod`, role/policy ARNs use `myapp-prod-*`
- prod policy keeps **no wildcard actions** and is scoped to exact ARNs only.

---

## Flux: append to `flux/kustomizations.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./overlays/dev/s3-logs
  prune: true
  wait: true
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./overlays/prod/s3-logs
  prune: true
  wait: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: s3-logs-base-prereqs   # existing IAM prereq kustomization, if present
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

Each env targets its own cluster/context Flux instance (the standard knr-ops pattern — one Flux per cluster reconciling only its overlay), so **changing prod never touches dev**.

## Verification

```bash
kustomize build overlays/dev/s3-logs | kubeconform -strict -
kustomize build overlays/prod/s3-logs | kubeconform -strict -
flux get kustomizations s3-logs
kubectl get bucket.logs myapp-logs-prod -o yaml  # confirm READY=True post-reconcile
```
